[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "agentforge-cognis"
version = "0.2.1"
description = "Build organizations of AI agents (roles, personalities, experience, skills, tools); run them, export to CrewAI/AutoGen/LangGraph/OpenHands/TaskWeaver/MetaGPT, sync to PM suites. Enterprise-ready: governance policy engine, audit trail, generic OpenAI backend. Interoperable with the Cognis suite."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.9"
license = { text = "LicenseRef-COCL-1.0" }
authors = [{ name = "Cognis Digital" }]
keywords = ["ai-agents", "multi-agent", "agent-orchestration", "llm", "crewai",
            "autogen", "langgraph", "openhands", "taskweaver", "agentops"]

[project.scripts]
"agentforge-emit" = "agentforge.connect:emit_main"
agentforge = "agentforge.cli:main"

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/cognis-digital/agentforge"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["agentforge"]

[project.optional-dependencies]
connect = ["cognis-connect @ git+https://github.com/cognis-digital/cognis-connect.git"]

[tool.hatch.metadata]
allow-direct-references = true

    # `enable_plugins=True` is passed. Uses the same llm_client/llm_model
    # pattern MarkItDown already uses for image descriptions, so it adds
    # OCR to embedded images inside DOCX/PPTX/XLSX and full-page OCR for
    # scanned PDFs without pulling in Tesseract or any ML binary.
    "markitdown-ocr>=0.0.1",
    "Markdown>=3.4",
    "reportlab>=4.0",
    "PyMuPDF>=1.25",
]
rag = [
    "lancedb>=0.6",
    "pyarrow>=14.0",
]
redis = [
    "redis>=5.0",
]
postgres = [
    "asyncpg>=0.30",
    "psycopg2-binary>=2.9",
]
database = [
    "sqlparse>=0.6",
    "cryptography>=50.0.0",
    "aiomysql>=0.2",
]
# KingbaseES (人大金仓) is PG protocol compatible; reuses asyncpg from [postgres].
# Kept as an alias extra so operators can opt in explicitly from deploy manifests.
kingbase = [
    "asyncpg>=0.30",
]
# DM8 (达梦) driver. ``dmPython`` is not on PyPI — operators must download
# the wheel from https://eco.dameng.com/ and install it manually, e.g.
# ``uv pip install path/to/dmPython-<ver>-cp<py>-*.whl``. Leaving this
# extra empty ensures ``uv sync --extra dm8`` succeeds so we can wire
# CI/docs around the name without forcing a broken install.
dm8 = []

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/fim-ai/fim-one"
Repository = "https://github.com/fim-ai/fim-one"
Issues = "https://github.com/fim-ai/fim-one/issues"
Website = "https://one.fim.ai"
Company = "https://fim.ai"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/fim_one"]

[tool.uv]
# Security floors for libraries we do not import directly. Direct
# dependencies (litellm, PyJWT, mcp, cryptography) are floored above.
constraint-dependencies = [
    "aiohttp>=3.14.4",
    "anyio>=4.14.2",
    "filelock>=4.2.10",
    "mako>=1.4.2",
    "pillow>=13.0.0",
    "soupsieve>=2.9.0",
    "starlette>=1.3.1",
    "urllib3>=2.8.0",
]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py311"
line-length = 100
src = ["src"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "N", "UP", "B", "SIM", "RUF"]

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.11"
strict = true
warn_return_any = true
warn_unused_configs = true

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
# fim_one resolves as an untyped installed package when mypy is invoked on
# evals/ alone (src layout without py.typed), so evals imports carry
# ignore[import-untyped] and the harness subclasses an Any-typed tool.  When
# a src/ file shares the mypy command line, fim_one DOES resolve and those
# ignores become unused — warn_unused_ignores stays off so the evals files
# type-check cleanly in both regimes (the pre-commit hook checks whatever
# happens to be staged together).
module = "evals.*"
warn_unused_ignores = false
disallow_subclassing_any = false

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
asyncio_mode = "auto"
timeout = 30
markers = [
    "docker: mark test as requiring a running Docker daemon",
    "regression: eval tier — a production bug frozen after its fix (pass@k)",
    "challenge: eval tier — a policy probe the agent must never fail (pass^k)",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pytest-timeout>=2.4.0",
]

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=77.0.3"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "bb-harness"
version = "4.1.1"
description = "Manual black-box test harness with an optional OpenAI-compatible Local Mode"
readme = "README.md"
license = "LicenseRef-RNA-TPSAL-1.0"
license-files = [
  "LICENSE",
  "LICENSE.ja.md",
  "NOTICE",
  "LICENSING.md",
  "COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md",
  "THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md"
]
authors = [
    {name = "RNA4219"}
]
requires-python = ">=3.10"
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 4 - Beta",
    "Environment :: Console",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.13",
    "Topic :: Software Development :: Testing",
]

dependencies = [
    "pyyaml>=6.0",
    "jsonschema>=4.0",
    "referencing>=0.30",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
api = ["requests>=2.28"]
notion = ["requests>=2.28"]
dev = ["pytest>=7.0", "pytest-cov>=4.0", "ruff>=0.1", "trove-classifiers==2026.6.1.19"]
all = ["bb-harness[api,notion,dev]"]

[project.scripts]
bb-harness = "bb_harness.cli:main"

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/RNA4219/manual-bb-test-harness"
Repository = "https://github.com/RNA4219/manual-bb-test-harness"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]
[tool.setuptools.package-data]
bb_harness = ["schemas/*.json", "local_profiles.yaml"]


[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
python_files = ["test_*.py"]
python_classes = ["Test*"]
python_functions = ["test_*"]
addopts = "-v --tb=short"
pythonpath = ["scripts", "src"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
extend-exclude = ["build", "dist", "tmp", "tmp-release-bundle"]
target-version = "py310"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "UP", "B"]
ignore = ["BLE001"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"scripts/*.py" = ["E501"]  # Long docstrings with usage examples
"tests/*.py" = ["E501"]    # Long test assertions
"src/bb_harness/tools/*.py" = ["E501"]  # Compatibility tool implementations
"src/bb_harness/local_pipeline.py" = ["E501"]  # Japanese prompts and compact render rows

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["scripts", "src/bb_harness"]
branch = true

[tool.coverage.report]
fail_under = 85
exclude_lines = [
    "pragma: no cover",
    "if __name__ == .__main__.:",
    "raise SystemExit",
]
